reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, and I don't need one: I put the same amount into index funds every payday and it already runs itself for free. A cute pet and a monthly fee don't fix a problem I don't have.
objection: Letting an AI move my actual savings, even within limits, makes me nervous, and paying a monthly fee on top when I have under $20k invested would eat into returns that my plain index funds get almost for free.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on demo money for months without doing anything dumb, plus a real-money account held at a licensed broker I've heard of, at a price that's tiny next to what I invest.
